title: Oh, Shenandoah
physical_identity: Foggy 25 km2 rolling hills in permanent daylight, surrounded by a perpetually night-bound deciduous forest holding a giant-spider super-colony of Nguithr'xurh; sheep country.
scale_topology: 25 km2 central area; surrounding forest of undetermined size; hills up to ~80 m.
anomalies: Forest noclip exit with 65% chance beyond 6 km
lighting_sound: Constant daylight inside, night in forest; dense fog; sound not stated.

entities.name: Nguithr'xurh
entities.behavior: Super-colony in the surrounding forest; huge specimens; not in the central area; lethal to unaligned travelers.

entities.name: Shenandoah Sheep
entities.behavior: About 15,000 sheep; fog-hydrating; managed by Murphy Estate.

entities.name: Murphy Estate humans (Jacob Murphy, family rumoured)
entities.behavior: Only permanent human presence; family rumoured to maintain the herd.

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Nguithr'xurh, Shenandoah Sheep, Murphy Estate humans
items_communities: B.N.T.G. (wool, lanolin, mutton, milk, tallow, leather)

entrances.method: Walk through a heavily forested section; seamless transition
entrances.conditions: arrives in forest ~4 km from central border
entrances.quote: In all instances, travelers were walking through heavily forested sections of these levels when the transition seamlessly occurred.
any heavily forested area could potentially lead into Level 77

exits.method: Walk in surrounding forest beyond 6 km; noclip through detritus
exits.risk: Nguithr'xurh territory (95% of unaligned travelers die)
exits.quote: When walking through the surrounding forest, at any distance greater than 6 km, a traveler will have a 65% chance to no-clip through the detritus

signature_mechanic: Fog-bound daylit hills ringed by a night forest of giant Nguithr'xurh; entry is 4 km inside the forest and exit a 65% noclip beyond 6 km.
verticality: Hills from under 1 m to nearly 80 m; no towers.
do_not: Do not place Nguithr'xurh in the central area.
Do not invent the Murphy Estate layout.
Do not make the forest daytime.
Do not add other exits beyond the forest noclip and B.N.T.G. route (unspecified).
content_warnings: 95% of unaligned travelers do not survive the Nguithr'xurh territory (implied deaths)
conflicts_notes: Entities section says 'only two' inhabitants but also lists humans of the Murphy Estate. Link list includes Levels 76 and 78 not explained in text.

key_quotes.quote: Stuck in a bisected diurnal cycle, the central area of Level 77 remains in constant daylight while the surrounding forest appears nightbound.
Level 77 experiences one consistent atmospheric condition: fog.
no Nguithr'xurh have ever been seen in the central area of the level
95% of unaligned travelers do not survive their territory
all entrances to the level occur within the forest, approximately 4 km from the border of the central area
a traveler will have a 65% chance to no-clip through the detritus
